direction: Restrained Apple-inspired translucency, shallow depth, soft colors, thin edge highlights, and calm typography
icon: Style-transfer correction: the user wants Apple's restrained Liquid Glass visual language. Use the supplied FLAT Functionalities icon as the exact shape reference, and create a minimal, quiet macOS-style app icon with a VERY SUBTLE thin translucent material. Preserve the exact four hollow diamond tiles (violet at top, teal at left, warm amber at right, blue below) and two blue V platform strokes, their spacing, centered layout, relative sizes, and front-facing silhouette. The glyph should still read as clean flat graphic geometry, with shallow layered depth and only tiny soft optical highlights along its edges. Colors are softened and slightly translucent, with quiet colored refraction, not bright jewel colors. Put the mark on a calm near-white gently translucent rounded-square tile. A single faint hairline white highlight follows the tile's perimeter; the tile has almost no visible thickness. Soft ambient light, tiny diffused shadow, neutral airy palette, ample breathing room, polished simplicity. Keep color in the small glyph; the tile itself is nearly colorless. Think Apple Liquid Glass: light transmitting through a thin optical surface, subtle edge bending, soft translucency and precise geometry. Do NOT make thick resin tubes, puffy gummy shapes, deep extrusion, chrome borders, faceted gems, concentric bevel rings, vivid gradient bands, specular streaks, glow, glitter, sparkles, neon colors, over-reflective plastic, heavy shadows, visual noise, decorative objects, or letters. Transparent outside the tile with clean smooth alpha corners. High resolution square PNG, legible at 128px. The finish should be understated enough that the material is noticed after the symbol, not before.
banner: Revise this banner toward Apple's understated Liquid Glass aesthetic. Image 1 is the flat Dynamic Functionalities bento composition and exact wording reference. Image 2 is the revised restrained icon to use and match. Preserve the five-panel bento layout, the large left product panel, four right feature panels, all words, broad spacing, and extra-wide 1544x500 aspect ratio (3.088:1). Rebuild the material as THIN, almost colorless translucent UI surfaces: soft background blur passing through each panel, a single hairline white edge, tiny gentle edge refraction, nearly imperceptible depth, and a soft low-opacity shadow. It should look like a refined Apple macOS/iOS product design, not a 3D resin render. Make the entire composition LIGHT and airy. Replace the dark navy hero panel with pale pearl translucent glass, dark charcoal title text, and clean readable supporting copy. Use calm, soft typography: a clean medium/semibold modern sans-serif heading, not the heavy black letterforms of the original; retain clear product-name hierarchy. Use the revised icon from image 2 at the existing small brand-icon position. The four module glyphs remain crisp clean monoline symbols, colored mildly; no extruded glossy material on those symbols. Feature panels are mostly clear/white, with the faintest warm amber, sage/mint, lilac, and sky-blue tint filtering through the background. The pale backdrop may have a very gentle broad pastel wash that explains translucency, but no shapes, blobs, objects, noise, or strong gradients. Material effects must be subtle; content should be seen first. Exact text: 'WordPress toolkit'; 'Dynamic' then 'Functionalities'; 'Enable only what you need.'; '19 optional modules'; 'Free and open source'; 'Content Tools'; 'Duplicate into drafts'; 'Link Health'; 'Find broken links'; 'Fonts & styles'; 'Built for reuse'; 'Site Activity'; 'See what changed'. Keep text flat, sharp, front-facing and high contrast, with generous padding. No chrome, shiny tubes, colored rims, thick borders, double outlines, bright specular streaks, saturated blue hero card, deep bevels, chunky or puffy glass, neon glow, candy-like highlights, floating objects, confetti, droplets, glitter, fake UI, watermarks, gibberish, or cropped copy. Keep the outer edges and shadow soft and calm. Deliver a very wide horizontal banner, same aspect as image 1, clean and understated, ready for WordPress listing PNG sizes.
